summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Hanna Dewo/238)

data.turoyo: ḤD. E, saymiwa naqqawoṯe mǧadala, saymíwayna aḥna, lo+mankrìwayna.
data.translation: HD. Yes, sometimes would struggle, we would do it, we would not apostatize.

rationale: First Infectum-wa III.1 box; absolute religious denial with omitted faith/Christ complement.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC Hanna Dewo/243)

data.turoyo: Yawo, u+hno, u+Ǧərǧo omar, ‘Qay hawxa səmlux, Galo? ‘Əə, gmoqaḏno u+babayḏe, ma gəzzí mankaṇṇo!?’
data.translation: Wow, the whatsit, Jərjo says, ‘Why did you do so, Galo?’ ‘Uh, I shall burn his father, am I going to apostatize?!’

rationale: Thin Infectum III.1 and unusual r+n assimilation mankaṇṇo; rhetorical question in context, no separate apostatise sense.

data.turoyo: Aṯina gab u qašo, u qašo stene lo mṣadaqle w lo mankarle <...>
data.translation: Wir sind zum Pfarrer gegangen, und der Pfarrer hat es weder bestätigt noch geleugnet; <...>

rationale: Unusual retained rl in mankarle contrasts with mankalle base; brief paired confirmation/denial context.

data.turoyo: W i naqqa d komər “šoriṭ”, yaʕni ṭro noše lo moḥela, latyo emi, komankanna. I naqqayo noše layba moḥela, hul d l oṯe w maqəṯ i ḥaṭrayḏe disa eba, mtaʕmažla.
data.translation: Sagt er: "schōrît", so heißt das: Laßt sie niemand schlagen, sie ist nicht meine Mutter, ich verleugne sie. Dann kann niemand sieschlagen, bis er kommt, sie wieder mit seinem Stocke berührt und sie durch taʕmîj - rufen wieder als "Mutter" annimmt.

rationale: Thin Infectum III.1; suffixal inanimate patient treated as mother in the game, making disowning and re-adoption explicit.

summary: All eight occurrences support existing III.1 (ver)leugnen. Objects include propositions, faith and a game object with a fictive kin relation.
Mankrìwayna adds Infectum-wa. Mankaṇṇo shows strong r+n assimilation; mankarle preserves rl, contrasting with the inherited mankalle.
Hors 2/13 = existing MM 13 wording, PrS 68/76 repeats prs 195/15, 43/6 is already quoted, and Talay 1/94 repeats LB 94. No duplicate examples or unsupported citation replacements.
The untranslated Ilyas p.c. example is preserved as supplied; no edition translation is invented.
Can the b-Mšiḥo complement be freely omitted in the absolute religious-denial construction?
Confirm segmentation/assimilation of mankaṇṇo and komankanna; retained rl forms remain verbatim.
Absolute religious renunciation omits faith/Christ, already attested with bə Mšiḥo; no new apostatise sense.
Game object called mother is temporarily disowned; this extends a participant already covered by the nest-disowning example.
